_schema: W12 diff-adjudication registry (user ruling 2026-11-18, GAPS 2.2#12): the sandbox realchain battery performs NO bug adjudication — every divergence is exported to .test-logs/diff-reports/ and matched here. Entry fields: id, scenario_pattern (exact scenario or '*'), state_pattern (optional, default '*'), shape ({kind: substring|regex, ref_contains/rust_contains: all must appear in the divergence line, rust_missing: none may appear}), classification (framework-diff|env-artifact|accepted-gap|expected-shape|needs-controller), justification, g_ref, adjudicated_by, adjudicated_at, last_observed. Matching is most-specific-first (longest scenario_pattern, then file order); a divergence matched by NO entry = unadjudicated (checker exit 2 = merge gate red).
